responsibility: Declares the public interfaces exported by the RX backend implementation to the machine description and other backend code. It covers prologue/epilogue expansion, return handling, stack-multiple emission, address and constant predicates, condition-code helpers, branch splitting, RTL utility routines, interrupt-function queries, and the RAII-style rx_atomic_sequence helper class, as well as inline templates for scanning nearby insns for register definitions and uses during RX-specific RTL transformations.
